Favorite Light Roast Specialty Coffee Roasters:
1. Sey Coffee (East Williamsburg, Brooklyn, NY): Ultra-clean washed coffees roasted on a Loring S35 Kestrel. Subscriptions ship every other Tuesday.
2. Passenger Coffee (Lancaster, PA): Renowned for freezer-archived lots and meticulous agtron color sorting. Best source for rare Gesha and Pink Bourbon varieties.
3. Tim Wendelboe (Oslo, Norway): Pioneer of Nordic clean profile roasting. Direct farm relationships in Colombia (Finca El Suelo) and Kenya.
4. Onyx Coffee Lab (Rogers, Arkansas): Consistent blends (Southern Weather) and single origins with transparent roast analytics and brew guides.
